title: Fayxile fida
intro: qibaadah aqayyaareh uddur, rooci ellecabo xayyossuh seecimeh suge. Baxsale baaxol yenbeeh, ta muuci dadalteh imaan kee sabri. mabla fida amrissa wak, oson maqambaalin. Ken aydaadi diini gonah xaa.
clues: Anu mango nabiyyih xer waktih qammaala dooqah gacsak suge.
Yoo kee yiina dubuk ayrooraa kee lee luk sugneh nan goloh addat raqneh sugne.
Anu numma kee sabril yimixxige nabiyyi akkuh yenbe.
Anu yabba Yallah yeceenih yanin diini qarih rakiibo ugusuh cateh.
Yabba yoh warse wak soono yoh fida kah abam, Anu gacseh, ' atu elle amrisen innal ab.'
Yalli yok fidga qaraanak ruubak yi rammitiyya kunnabna yoh abe.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: kaxxa awka luk fidga yekkeh suge
outcome.answer: kaxxa awka luk fidga yekkeh suge

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
